online classifieds pakistan (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED 
   
 MINUTES OF THE RESOLUTIONS OF THE SOLE Director 
 OF THE COMPANY DATED _______________________ 202 2 
   
 Purpose of the RESOLUTIONS 
 IT WAS NOTED that the Company was proposing to provide a convertible loan to Daftarkhwan (Private) Limited , a company incorporated in Pakistan with company number 0102476 and whose registered office is at 3rd Floor, Vogue Towers, 15 C/2, Gulberg III, M.M. Alam Road, Lahore, Pakistan (“ Daftarkhwan ”) in the principal amount in PKR equal to US$ 250,000 (the “ Loan ”). It was noted that if Daftarkhwan fails to repay the Loan plus accrued interest by its maturity date , the Company would be issued preferred ordinary shares in Daftarkhwan in accordance with the terms of a convertible loan facility agreement (the “ Facility Agreement ”). 
 IT WAS NOTED that t he purpose of the meeting was to consider and, if thought fit, approve : 
 the granting of the Loan by Company ; 
 the entry into the Facility Agreement by the Company ; and 
 the subscription by the Company for shares in Daftarkhwan in the event that the Loan is converted i n to shares, in accordance with the terms of Facility Agreement (the “ Subscription ”) ; 
 (the “ Transaction ”) 
 IT WAS NOTED that the director of the Company (the “Director” ) has no personal interest, direct or indirect, in the matters contemplated by these resolutions which the Director is required to disclose in accordance with the constitutional documents of the Company or in accordance with applicable law, or otherwise, or which might disqualify the Director from approving these resolutions. 
 Documents 
 IT WAS NOTED that a draft of the Facility Agreement had been provided to the director . 
 Approval 
 IT WAS RESOLVED that : 
 the Loan be approved ; 
 entry into the Facility Agreement be approved ; and 
 the Subscription be approved. 
 IT WAS FURTHER RESOLVE D that Mr. Imran Ali Khan be authorised in the name and on behalf of the Company to execute (in the case of documents to be executed as a deed, with any other director or the secretary or by himself in the presence of a witness) and deliver all such further documents and to take all such further action as he may consider necessary or appropriate in connection with the Transaction. 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF , THIS RESOLUTION IS DULY EXECUTED BY, 
 
 ____________________________ 
 
 
 Company Secretary
